title: Understanding the Plot
text: Observe how each model's prediction line behaves in relation to the true observed values (the scatter points).

title: Model Variance
text: Consider what it means for a model to have low variance. How do the predictions of each model compare to each other?

title: Average Prediction Line
text: Look at the dotted line representing the average prediction. How does it relate to the individual model predictions?

title: Interpreting the Average Prediction
text: Does the average prediction line closely follow the trend of the true observed values?
